name: TAL
comments: A talinolol tablet formulation (Cordanum, 100 mg tablet) and the reference standard talinolol (Fig. 1b) were generously provided by Cordanum, Arzneimittelwerk Dresden Gmbh (Dresden, Germany).

name: GLY
comments: We used a commercially available compound glycyrrhizin tablets [Stronger Neo-Minophagen C (SNMC)] whose main constituents are glycyrrhizin (25 mg) (Fig. 1a)(monoammonium glycyrrhizinate, 35 mg), aminoacetic acid (25 mg) and methionine (25 mg). Dosing of compound glycyrrhizin tablets or placebo-tablets was as follows: three tablets at 7:40 a.m., three tablets at 1:00 p.m. and three tablets at 7:00 p.m. for 6 days.
